product: GTT Black KN95 disposable masks, 50-pack, individually wrapped (ELEHOME GTT shop)
status: Plan approved by Ralph 2026-10-03: full match, 10 shots, $2.75 Kie. Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) stills; Seedance 2.0 Mini clips.
identity_block: The hand is the ONLY person in the video: one woman's hands, medium-dark brown skin, slim fingers, SHORT squared nails that end just past the fingertips (a short free edge of about 2 mm, much shorter than the nails in the hand reference images; use those images for skin tone, hand shape and nail colour only), with a glossy pale lilac-white base and a narrow white tip band on every nail (ignore the annotation text and leader lines in those images). Only the hand enters from the frame edge, whole wrist visible, no forearm, no face, no other people.
box_block: The box is exactly the GTT KN95 box in the box reference image and its colour is SILVER-GREY (a light grey carton: not blue, not white, not black, not beige): red 'GTT' logo top-left, a large black 'KN95' wordmark, 'DISPOSABLE PARTICULATE' under it, a blue band with a yellow '95', and a bottom white strip with a red and blue stripe reading 'INDIVIDUALLY WRAPPED' and '50 ALL ONE SIZE'. The box keeps this exact shape, colour and layout in every frame: no morphing, no extra text, no label drift.
mask_block: The mask is exactly the black mask in the mask reference image: a matte black 'fish-shape' 3D disposable mask with a wide soft rounded body, one horizontal fold crease across the middle where the lower half folds down and forward, tapering to a rounded point at the bottom centre, dotted stitched edging along the top and sides, a small black 'KN95' printed on the lower side panel, and thin black elastic ear loops at the sides. It is NOT a flat-fold mask with a vertical centre seam, NOT a duckbill, NOT pleated. It stays this exact shape in every frame.
wrap_block: Each mask is sealed in its own thin clear plastic sleeve, with the black fish-shape mask visible inside, same as the black mask in the reference image.
scene_block: Setting: a lived-in home garage, bare concrete floor, a wooden workbench with a pegboard of tools behind it, a car partly visible, the big garage door open on the right letting in soft early-autumn daylight, a few red and orange leaves outside. Shot on a phone, natural light, realistic unretouched skin texture with visible knuckle creases, casual and a little lived-in like a real person filmed it, no cinematic grading. No on-screen text or captions. No other branded products.
video_suffix: Fingers move naturally and stay anatomically correct (five fingers per hand). The camera does not move. No sound. No on-screen text.

shots.vo: A whole box of fifty masks. Let me show you why.
shots.still: Medium close-up at a wooden garage workbench: the hand, entering from the bottom edge of the frame, holds the GTT KN95 box upright and front-facing toward the lens, the lid closed; the garage door is open behind it, out of focus, soft autumn daylight.
shots.video: Shot 1: the hand holds the box steady front-on for a second, then tilts the box toward the lens and lifts the top flap open so a stack of individually wrapped masks shows inside. Locked-off camera on a tripod.

shots.still: Low angle on a dusty concrete garage floor: one hand grips a push broom handle from the top edge of the frame, the broom head rests on the floor with a fine haze of dust already rising in a shaft of daylight from the open garage door. No box, no mask, no other products.
shots.video: Shot 2a: the hand pushes the broom forward across the concrete in one slow stroke, a cloud of dust lifts and drifts in the light. Locked-off camera on a tripod.

shots.vo: or shake out a rug, and look at all that dust. You're breathing that too.
shots.still: The open garage doorway with soft daylight behind: the hand, entering from the TOP edge of the frame with only the hand and wrist visible, pinches the top corner of a worn grey doormat between thumb and fingers, so the whole mat hangs straight down from the hand under gravity, floppy, about the size of a doormat, with a little loose dust and lint on it. The palm does not touch or press the mat. No box, no mask, no other products.
shots.video: Shot 2b: the hand shakes the mat with two quick up-and-down flicks of the wrist, the hanging mat flaps and swings freely under gravity, and a big cloud of fine dust shakes out of it and falls and drifts in the daylight; the hand then holds it still while the dust hangs. The mat is never stuck to the hand. Locked-off camera on a tripod.

shots.vo: These are KN95s, so they filter out ninety-five percent or more, and they're made to be soft on your skin.
shots.still: Close-up at the garage workbench: the hand holds one black fish-shape mask up in front of the lens by its two ear loops so the whole mask shows; the garage is blurred behind. No box in the shot.
shots.video: Shot 3: the hand holds the mask steady by the loops, then the thumb brushes lightly across the soft fabric of the mask and settles. Locked-off camera on a tripod.

shots.vo: They're shaped like a fish to fit your face, and the loops stretch.
shots.still: Close-up at the garage workbench: the hand holds one black fish-shape mask up in side profile so its rounded fish shape shows; the other hand's finger and thumb hold one ear loop. Garage blurred behind. No box in the shot.
shots.video: Shot 4: the finger and thumb pull the ear loop out so the elastic stretches, then let it snap back; the mask stays in the other hand, steady. Locked-off camera on a tripod.

shots.still: Close-up at the garage workbench: the GTT KN95 box stands on the bench, front facing the camera, its carton colour silver-grey; the hand lifts one black mask, sealed in its own clear plastic sleeve, up out of the top opening of the box.
shots.video: Shot 5a: the hand lifts the wrapped mask up out of the box and holds it toward the lens. Locked-off camera on a tripod.

shots.vo: so keep a few in the car
shots.still: Inside a parked car: the hand, entering from the bottom of the frame, tucks two black masks, each sealed in a clear plastic sleeve, into the driver's door pocket beside the door handle, soft daylight through the window. No box.
shots.video: Shot 5b: the hand slides the two wrapped masks down into the door pocket and lets go. Locked-off camera on a tripod.

shots.vo: and a few in the garage.
shots.still: A garage shelf at the edge of the workbench: the hand, entering from the bottom of the frame, sets two black masks, each sealed in a clear plastic sleeve, on a wooden shelf beside a paint can and a tape measure. No box.
shots.video: Shot 5c: the hand sets the two wrapped masks down on the shelf and lifts away. Locked-off camera on a tripod.

shots.vo: The only problem? Now I can't say I forgot my mask.
shots.still: Close-up on the wooden workbench: the hand sets one black fish-shape mask down next to a pair of work gloves and a set of car keys. No box.
shots.video: Shot 6: the hand sets the mask down beside the gloves and keys, then taps it once with a fingertip. Locked-off camera on a tripod.

shots.vo: It's leaf season, so don't put this off. Fifty in a box, plenty to share. It's in the orange cart.
shots.still: Wide-ish view of the workbench at the open garage door where red and orange fall leaves have blown onto the concrete outside: the GTT KN95 box stands front-facing on the bench, its whole front visible; the hand enters from the right edge of the frame and grips the right side panel of the box between thumb and fingers, fingers wrapped around the side, the palm NOT on the front face.
shots.video: Shot 7: holding the box by its right side, the hand slides it smoothly across the bench toward the lens, the box staying front-facing and upright, then lets go and the hand slides out to the right edge. The hand never covers the front of the box. Locked-off camera on a tripod.

face_block: The person is Grace, exactly the woman in the first reference image (a character sheet with a front view and two three-quarter views): medium-dark brown skin, defined arched brows, almond dark-brown eyes, long knotless boho braids with loose curly ends worn half-up with the long curls falling over one shoulder, a thin gold chain with a small round pendant at her neck. She wears the same fitted brown long-sleeve top as in the reference images, no tee. Her brows are relaxed and her forehead smooth, no wrinkles. A black fish-shape mask is already on her face covering her nose and mouth completely, so her mouth is never visible; she is not speaking. Her hands have medium-dark brown skin, slim fingers and short squared nails with a pale lilac-white base. No other people.
